title: I Will Sing of Mercy and Justice
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite king sits in a modest royal courtyard, reflecting on the responsibilities of leadership. He wears a simple but finely woven mantle and a small crown, while two trusted advisers stand nearby. On a low table lies a plain scroll and a clay lamp. The king looks toward an open doorway where ordinary people move through the city, reminding him that his choices affect the community. In the background, one official speaks honestly with a petitioner, while another appears to hide a dishonest transaction. The king's expression is serious as he commits himself to mercy, justice, integrity, and a blameless way of life. A narrow path leads from the palace courtyard toward the city gate, visually connecting private character with public leadership. The scene should communicate the psalm's resolve to reject wickedness and a perverse heart, without portraying the king as flawless or inventing a documented court event. Historically plausible Israelite royal clothing, stone architecture, wooden furniture, and natural daylight. No modern objects, readable writing, or fantasy effects.

title: I Will Set No Wicked Thing before My Eyes
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite ruler oversees a small gathering of officials in a palace courtyard. A courtier begins whispering maliciously about a neighbor, while another offers a hidden gift in exchange for special treatment. The king raises his hand and refuses to encourage the slander or the dishonest bargain. Nearby, a trustworthy servant brings forward an honest report, and the ruler listens attentively. Outside the courtyard, ordinary workers move through the city, suggesting that the ruler's commitment to integrity has consequences for the whole community. The scene should reflect the psalm's rejection of slander, pride, deceit, and wicked conduct, as well as its aspiration to surround leadership with faithful people. Avoid depicting a literal modern personnel review or inventing a specific punishment. Use ancient robes, limestone walls, wooden doors, clay lamps, and realistic facial expressions. No modern office furniture, text, graphic violence, or fantasy effects.

title: Hear My Prayer, for My Days Are Consumed Like Smoke
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a solitary Israelite worshipper sits inside a modest stone dwelling, overwhelmed by prolonged distress. His shoulders are bent, his face is tired, and his hands are raised toward the heavens in a plea that God hear him quickly. A small oil lamp burns beside an empty clay bowl, while sunlight enters through a narrow opening and reveals dust in the air. Outside, a lone bird sits on a rooftop, and another small bird rests on the edge of the wall, evoking the psalm's images of loneliness. The worshipper appears isolated from the normal life of the town, and his expression conveys the feeling that days are disappearing like smoke and strength is fading like a shadow. Do not depict a specific illness or show graphic symptoms. The mood should remain compassionate and solemn, respecting the psalm's deep lament rather than forcing an immediate resolution. Historically plausible clothing, stone walls, clay vessels, and natural subdued light. No modern objects, readable text, or fantasy effects.

title: You Will Arise and Have Mercy upon Zion
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite city partly damaged by hardship, with workers beginning to repair a stone wall and clear rubble from a courtyard. An elder stands on a ridge overlooking Jerusalem, praying with renewed hope because he believes the LORD's time to show favor to Zion will come. Several families gather near the city gate, watching the repairs and beginning to prepare for ordinary life again. A mason places stones carefully into the wall while another worker carries water for the team. The scene should express the contrast between the permanence of God's years and the changing circumstances of human cities, while emphasizing that the LORD regards the prayer of the destitute and does not despise their petition. Let sunlight fall on the repaired section of wall, but do not depict the entire city miraculously restored in an instant. Use historically plausible architecture, simple tools, woven garments, and natural daylight. No modern construction machinery, text, or fantasy effects.

title: The LORD Looked Down from Heaven
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a group of elders and children gathers near a repaired section of Jerusalem's wall, listening as an older worshipper recounts God's enduring faithfulness and the hope of future generations. The elder points toward the sky, emphasizing that the heavens and earth may change, but the LORD remains the same. In the background, a scribe prepares a scroll to preserve the testimony for those yet unborn, while young people help rebuild a household and carry stones through the city. A broad view of the landscape stretches beyond the wall toward distant mountains and fields, visually contrasting the scale of creation with the enduring life of God's people. The mood is hopeful, patient, and intergenerational. Do not depict heaven as a literal human-shaped figure peering through the clouds. Use realistic ancient stonework, parchment materials, clothing, and natural light. No modern writing equipment, printed books, captions, or fantasy imagery.

title: Bless the LORD, O My Soul
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, David stands on a terrace above ancient Jerusalem at sunrise, speaking in prayer and thanksgiving with his entire being engaged in praise. His hands are open and his face expresses gratitude as he remembers the LORD's benefits, forgiveness, healing, redemption, lovingkindness, and renewal. Below the terrace, ordinary life begins: a family prepares bread, a shepherd gathers sheep, and an older person is helped along a narrow street. These details should not imply that every illness or difficulty has been removed from all individuals; they illustrate the broad gratitude expressed by the psalmist. Beyond the city, a winding road recalls God's way being made known through Moses and His acts to Israel. The sunrise provides a natural symbol of renewed strength, while the architecture and clothing remain consistent with ancient Israel. Use realistic stone walls, woven garments, olive trees, and warm natural light. No modern objects, visible text, or fantasy effects.

title: The LORD Is Merciful and Gracious
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a father in an ancient Israelite household kneels beside a child who has made a mistake, speaking with patience rather than harshness. His expression is compassionate, and the child listens attentively. Nearby, an elder helps a neighbor resolve a disagreement through truthful conversation and fair treatment. David stands in the background, reflecting on God's mercy, patience, and willingness to forgive, while the scene includes a broad open sky and distant mountains to evoke the immeasurable height of God's lovingkindness. A handful of soil rests in the foreground beside a clay vessel, reminding viewers of the psalm's image of human beings formed from dust and deserving compassion because their lives are fragile. Do not depict God as a literal human father or imply that wrongdoing has no consequences. The theme is mercy rooted in understanding human weakness. Historically plausible clothing, stone walls, natural light, and realistic expressions. No modern objects, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: As for Man, His Days Are as Grass
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a wide hillside in ancient Israel shows grasses and small wildflowers moving in the breeze. In the foreground, a child runs through a patch of green grass while an elderly worshipper sits beneath an olive tree, illustrating the contrast between the brief span of human life and the enduring steadfast love of God through generations. Beyond them, families live and work in a small settlement, while a group of worshippers gathers near a sanctuary to bless the LORD. The sky stretches over the landscape, and birds move naturally in the distance, suggesting the heavenly host and all creation joining in praise. The composition should convey that people flourish for a time and fade, while God's mercy endures for those who fear Him and keep His covenant. Avoid making the scene melancholy or suggesting that old age diminishes human worth. Accurate ancient clothing, realistic plants, stone buildings, and natural afternoon light. No modern objects, text, or fantasy effects.

title: You Are Clothed with Honor and Majesty
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism with a grand view of creation from a high mountain overlooking an ancient Near Eastern landscape. A vast sky stretches above clouds, mountain ridges, deep valleys, and distant waters. Sunlight breaks across the slopes while clouds gather over the peaks, suggesting majesty, light, and the winds that serve God's purposes. In the foreground, an Israelite worshipper stands beside a rocky outcrop and raises his face in awe. The land below shows the boundaries between dry ground and water, with a river carving its way through the valley. The image should communicate the psalm's poetic portrayal of God as clothed in light, stretching out the heavens, laying the beams of His chambers upon the waters, and establishing the earth securely. Do not depict God as a visible human figure or turn the landscape into a literal architectural diagram. Use realistic atmospheric perspective, clouds, rock, water, and ancient clothing. No modern structures, text, or fantasy effects.

title: Springs, Birds, and Beasts Receive Their Water
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a lush valley in ancient Israel where water emerges from springs among rocky hills and flows toward cultivated fields. Deer approach the stream cautiously, birds nest in branches, and small animals move through grass near the water's edge. Shepherds guide sheep along an upper path while farmers tend vineyards and olive trees on terraces. Tall mountain ridges stand behind the valley, and a few wild goats move across rocky ledges. The composition should express how springs water the beasts, birds make their homes among trees, and mountains provide refuge for wild creatures. Human life and animal life should coexist naturally within a believable ancient ecosystem. Avoid making animals behave like domestic pets or inserting species foreign to the region. Use realistic water movement, accurate animal anatomy, local vegetation, and natural daylight. No modern irrigation pipes, farm machinery, artificial ponds, or fantasy creatures.

title: The Moon Marks the Seasons and the Sea Teems with Life
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a broad coastal landscape from late evening into moonlit night. The moon rises over the sea, illuminating waves and a small fleet of ancient fishing boats. In the foreground, fishermen prepare nets beside the shoreline while other families light oil lamps in houses near the harbor. Farther inland, farmers use the changing light and seasonal patterns to guide their work. Birds fly toward their nests, and wild animals move across the hills as darkness settles, reflecting the psalm's rhythms of day and night. At sea, fish and other marine creatures appear naturally beneath the clear water near the shore, suggesting the great variety of life in the waters and the creatures moving through them. The image should express how creation follows appointed seasons and how the sea teems with life. Use historically plausible boats, nets, garments, realistic water, natural moonlight, and local coastal terrain. No modern vessels, electric lights, or fantasy sea monsters.

title: You Renew the Face of the Earth
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite valley during the transition from a dry season into renewed growth after rainfall. Farmers watch clouds pass and then begin tending refreshed fields as water flows again through small channels. Sheep graze on newly green pasture, birds return to trees, and children carry water jars beside their parents. An elder stands on a low ridge, reflecting on how all living creatures depend upon God's provision and how breath and life are sustained. In the background, one area of dry earth remains visible, keeping the natural cycle realistic rather than making every part of the landscape instantly lush. The scene conveys gratitude for creation's continuing renewal and the hope that praise will endure while the earth remains. A distant patch of sunlight touches the refreshed fields, symbolizing renewal rather than a literal supernatural beam. Authentic ancient clothing, agricultural tools, realistic local plants, and natural light. No modern weather equipment, machinery, or fantasy effects.

title: Remember God's Covenant with Abraham
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, Abraham stands beside his household at the edge of a vast ancient Near Eastern landscape, looking toward distant hills and open land under a clear sky. His clothing and possessions reflect the life of a traveling patriarch, with woven tents, pack animals, clay vessels, and simple household goods arranged nearby. His family members gather to hear a reminder of God's promise to give the land to his descendants. The scene should convey the covenant made with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the call to seek the LORD and make His deeds known, and the promise that endured even when the descendants were few in number. In the foreground, an elder speaks to younger family members, linking the covenant story to future generations. Keep the landscape historically plausible for the ancient Near East and avoid modern borders or national imagery. Realistic tents, livestock, garments, and natural daylight. No modern objects, readable scroll text, or fantasy effects.

title: From a Few Sojourners to a Great People in Egypt
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a sequence in one connected landscape showing the early descendants of Abraham moving through the ancient Near East. In the foreground, a small patriarchal household travels with pack animals and tents, appearing few in number among the wide hills. In the middle distance, the family arrives in a more settled region and grows over generations, with children, flocks, and household workers visible around their dwellings. In a later section of the same composition, a family descends into Egypt during a time of need, carrying belongings and seeking food. The Egyptian setting should be historically grounded, with mudbrick buildings, river channels, agricultural fields, and simple clothing appropriate to the period. Joseph's rise from hardship to authority may be suggested by a royal storehouse and officials overseeing grain, without inventing detailed episodes beyond the psalm. The scene should also foreshadow the growth of Israel into a numerous people whose presence becomes significant in Egypt. No anachronistic details, readable text, or fantasy effects.

title: Moses, Aaron, and the Signs in Egypt
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a broad ancient Egyptian setting showing Moses and Aaron before the Egyptian authorities while the land experiences the plagues remembered in the psalm. Moses stands with a staff, speaking solemnly, and Aaron is beside him. In the wider composition, the Nile and agricultural fields are troubled, frogs gather near water and household entrances, swarms of insects appear among plants, and crops show damage from hail. Darkness is suggested by unusually dim skies over part of the landscape, while distant houses and storehouses remain visible. The scene should convey a succession of signs that challenge Egypt's power and prepare for Israel's deliverance, without portraying every plague as occurring at one instant. Do not show graphic harm or turn the insects and animals into fantasy monsters. Use historically plausible Egyptian architecture, linen garments, mudbrick buildings, river ecology, and natural dramatic light. No modern objects, graphic violence, readable captions, or fantasy effects.

title: God Brought His People Out and Gave Them the Land
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a large company of Israelites journeys away from Egypt through the wilderness. Families carry bundles, children walk beside their parents, and shepherds guide sheep and goats. Moses and Aaron lead the people along a rocky path as a cloud stretches across the sky, symbolizing guidance without depicting a supernatural figure. In the distance, a body of water and the opening route through the wilderness recall the remembered deliverance, while later parts of the landscape show food gathered on the ground and birds descending near the camp, illustrating provision during the journey. The composition transitions toward cultivated hills and the first settlements in the promised land, where families begin tending fields and building modest homes. It should communicate God's fulfillment of the promise, His provision, and the purpose that His people might keep His statutes and observe His laws. Avoid combining all stages of the Exodus into one literal moment; present them as connected remembered scenes. Historically plausible ancient clothing, animals, tents, and terrain. No modern objects, graphic danger, or fantasy effects.

title: Give Thanks to the LORD for He Is Good
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite worship courtyard where people gather to give thanks to the LORD for His goodness and enduring mercy. Elders, families, and younger worshippers stand together beneath a simple fabric canopy, while musicians tune their instruments before singing. A respected elder raises his hands in prayer, asking to see the good of God's chosen people and to rejoice in the joy of the nation. Nearby, a family welcomes a traveler and offers him a place to sit, symbolizing the blessedness of living within a community shaped by God's justice and covenant faithfulness. The setting includes stone paving, woven garments, clay jars, and an open view toward the surrounding hills. The atmosphere should be reverent and hopeful, with gratitude for God's enduring goodness rather than celebration of human merit. Historically plausible Israelite architecture and clothing, natural morning light. No modern worship equipment, printed lyrics, or fantasy effects.

title: Our Ancestors Rebelled, Yet God Delivered Them
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a historical tableau of the Israelites in Egypt and at the sea. In the foreground, several Israelites stand at the shore, frightened by the approaching danger behind them and the water before them. Moses raises his staff as the path through the sea opens, and families begin moving forward between the water walls with children, elderly people, and livestock. In a smaller connected scene in the background, some people argue anxiously and question whether God will rescue them, while others begin following the leaders. The water appears immense and natural, and no one is shown drowning or injured. This image should convey the psalm's confession that the ancestors did not understand God's wonders in Egypt and rebelled at the sea, yet the LORD delivered them for His name's sake so that His power would be known. Use historically plausible ancient clothing, rocky shoreline, realistic water and sky. No modern boats, graphic danger, text, or fantasy creatures.

title: They Forgot God's Works and Made a Golden Calf
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an Israelite wilderness camp showing the shift from divine provision to impatience and disobedience. In one area, people gather food and water, remembering that God has provided for them; in another, a crowd gathers around a small golden calf fashioned from metal, while some celebrate and others look uncertain. Moses stands at a distance on rocky ground, returning from the mountain and reacting with grief at the people's behavior. A few elders try to quiet the gathering, but much of the camp remains distracted by the idol. The scene should refer to the wilderness rebellion and the golden calf described in Israel's history without adding graphic judgment or portraying every person as equally involved. The visual contrast between God's provision and the people's misplaced worship is central. Use historically plausible Israelite tents, metalworking tools, clothing, and dusty terrain. No modern objects, exaggerated idol size, graphic violence, or fantasy effects.

title: They Despised the Promised Land and Grieved Moses
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a group of Israelite scouts returns from surveying a fertile land, carrying a cluster of grapes and other produce to show the goodness of the territory. Some scouts look confident in the land's fruitfulness, while others speak fearfully about the strength of its inhabitants. Around the camp, several people sit with lowered heads and begin complaining rather than trusting God's promise. Moses stands before the gathering with a burdened expression, trying to guide the people through their fear and rebellion. In a connected wilderness scene, water emerges from a rocky place while Moses gestures in frustration, recalling the incident in which he spoke rashly under pressure. The land beyond should look fertile and believable, with hills, fields, trees, and settlements. The image should express unbelief, resistance to guidance, and the cost of disobedience without adding an invented battle. Historically plausible ancient clothing, grapes and agricultural produce, tents, and natural light. No modern maps, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: Remember Us, O LORD, with Your Saving Help
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite settlement during a period when the people have adopted practices from surrounding nations. Some residents gather around foreign religious objects, while others take part in customs that disregard the LORD's commands. The setting should be historically respectful and avoid sensational depictions of ritual violence. In the foreground, an Israelite worshipper kneels in confession, acknowledging the community's wrongdoing and asking God to remember His covenant. Several families stand nearby, showing sorrow and concern for their children. Beyond the settlement, foreign rulers and neighboring peoples are visible across a broad valley, suggesting that Israel is vulnerable among the nations. The composition should also express the closing hope that God hears the people's cry, remembers His covenant, and gathers them from among the nations. Let the final part of the landscape show an open road leading toward a place of worship. Historically plausible architecture, clothing, and natural light. No graphic details, modern objects, captions, or fantasy effects.

title: He Satisfies the Longing Soul
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a group of weary travelers crosses a dry wilderness in the ancient Near East. They carry simple bags and water jars, and their clothing is dusty from a long journey. Some look toward distant hills, uncertain of the road ahead, while an elder points toward a settlement visible beyond the valley. The landscape conveys how the travelers wandered in a lonely place and struggled to find a place to dwell. In the next part of the composition, they enter the settlement and receive water, bread, and a place to rest from a welcoming household. Their expressions change from exhaustion to gratitude as they give thanks to the LORD for steadfast love and deliverance. The scene should express the psalm's invitation to the redeemed to recount their rescue and the image of God satisfying the thirsty soul and filling the hungry with good things. Use historically plausible travel clothing, pack animals, water jars, stone dwellings, and natural light. No modern vehicles, bottles, road signs, or fantasy effects.

title: He Breaks the Gates of Bronze
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient fortified town with a heavy gate and a dim holding area within the city wall. Several prisoners sit in a shaded chamber, tired and discouraged after a long period of confinement. Their wrists are free of graphic restraints, and no injuries are shown. One elderly prisoner lowers his head in prayer while a younger man looks toward a narrow opening where sunlight enters. The setting reflects their distress, the darkness and shadow of confinement, and the need for release from a situation they cannot escape alone. In a connected view outside the gate, the heavy doors stand open and the people begin walking into the daylight, while an elder welcomes them and offers water. The gate should appear opened through ordinary circumstances, not by an oversized supernatural hand. The image communicates God's deliverance, breaking the bars and bringing prisoners out of darkness. Use realistic ancient stonework, timber, simple garments, and natural contrast between shade and sunlight. No modern prison architecture, graphic suffering, or fantasy effects.

title: He Sent His Word and Healed Them
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient Israelite household where a weakened person rests on a woven mat in a shaded room. Family members sit nearby with expressions of concern, and one brings a clay cup of water while another adjusts a simple blanket. The person is shown with dignity and without graphic symptoms. The scene evokes the psalm's description of people whose foolish ways bring distress and who cry out to God for help. In a connected part of the courtyard, the family begins to prepare a thanksgiving offering after the person regains strength, while an elder gives thanks to the LORD for deliverance and healing. Do not depict a literal magical word entering the room or claim that every illness has a particular moral cause; the passage is a poetic testimony of rescue. Use historically plausible household materials, simple garments, clay vessels, stone walls, and soft natural light. No modern medical equipment, graphic detail, or fantasy effects.

title: He Stills the Storm and Brings Sailors to Their Haven
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, an ancient wooden trading vessel at sea during a dangerous storm. Sailors in simple woven garments pull ropes and secure cargo while large waves rise around the hull. Dark clouds cover the sky and spray blows across the deck, making the ship appear small against the power of the sea. One sailor looks upward in prayer while another holds the side rail, showing that their skill and effort cannot fully control the storm. In the distance, a rocky coastline and a sheltered harbor are barely visible. The composition should move toward calmer water and a safe landing, representing how God brings the storm to stillness and guides the sailors to their desired haven. No one falls into the water, and no graphic danger is shown. Use historically plausible ancient ship construction, natural storm physics, realistic waves, ropes and sails, and believable lighting. No modern engines, navigation equipment, or fantasy effects.

title: He Turns Wilderness into Springs of Water
image_prompt: Biblical historical realism, a broad view of the ancient Near Eastern countryside showing dramatic changes across the land. In one area, a dry streambed and neglected fields lie beneath harsh sunlight, while another area receives water from a spring and begins to support green growth. Families settle near the renewed water source, build modest stone dwellings, plant crops, and care for livestock. At the edge of the village, an elder watches a formerly barren patch of land begin to produce food, acknowledging that God can humble the proud and lift up the needy. A traveler rests beneath a tree near the spring, while children carry small clay jars to their homes. The image should convey the psalm's reversals: wilderness becoming pools, dry land becoming springs, the hungry finding a settled home, and the humble flourishing under God's care. Avoid suggesting that a specific historical drought or flood is being documented. Use realistic ancient farming, stone terraces, local vegetation, and natural light. No modern irrigation machinery, captions, or fantasy effects.
